name: a holding partly sold at several prices keeps the average cost of what is left
spec: SPEC.md §2 Trade (FIFO lots; P&L; Entry; Exit; Qty); SPEC.md §2 Position (Qty; Book at average cost, commissions in; Avg cost; Market; P&L) and the paragraph after its table; §4 Dashboard (Realized P&L tile, closed-trade count)
working: CAD book, no fees. Lots: t1 100 for 1,000 (10 each); t2 100 for 2,000 (20 each).
Trade (FIFO): t3 sells 100 for 3,000 against lot t1 cost 1,000 -> 2,000; t4 sells 50 for 1,250 against 50 of lot t2 at 20 = 1,000 -> 250. P&L realized so far = 2,000 + 250 = 2,250.00.
Qty = units opened = 200; Entry = (1,000 + 2,000) / 200 = 15; Exit = (3,000 + 1,250) / 150 = 28.3333... (does not terminate; written to 4 places as the example's entry is, 28.3333).
50 units still held, so the trade is open: closed = open.
Position (average cost): after the buys Book 3,000 on 200 units, average 15. t3 takes 100/200 of the cost: Book 1,500 on 100. t4 takes 50/100 of that: Book 750.00 on 50 (average still 15).
KPI, no filter: realized = 2,250.00 (open trades' partial sales count); no closed trade: count 0, wins 0, losses 0.

name: commissions are in a holding's cost, and a sale leaves the average where it was
spec: SPEC.md §2 Trade (FIFO lots; P&L; Entry; Exit; Qty); SPEC.md §2 Position (Qty; Book at average cost, commissions in; Avg cost; Market; P&L) and the paragraph after its table
working: Trade (FIFO): t3 closes 5 of lot t1. (70 - 50) x 5 = 100, less the exit commission 9.99 and the closed units' share of the entry commission 9.99 x 5/10 = 4.995: P&L = 100 - 9.99 - 4.995 = 85.015 = cash check 340.01 - 509.99 x 5/10. Written to 2 places half-even: 85.02.
Position Book: purchases with commissions 509.99 + 609.99 = 1,119.98 on 20 units (average 55.999). t3 takes 5/20 of it: Book = 1,119.98 x 15/20 = 839.985, written half-even 839.98.
Avg = 839.985 / 15 = 55.999 (exact), unchanged by the sale.
Market = 15 x 70 = 1,050.00; unrealized = 1,050 - 839.985 = 210.015, written half-even 210.02 (also 210.02 if Book is first held to cents as 839.98).

name: a return of capital lowers the average cost, a later partial sale keeps it, and capital returned beyond the cost is realized
spec: SPEC.md §2 Trade (FIFO lots; P&L; Entry; Exit; Qty); SPEC.md §2 What you enter (return of capital: lowers cost of units held on the day paid; beyond a lot's cost is realized that day, cost then zero); SPEC.md §2 Position (Qty; Book at average cost, commissions in; Avg cost; Market; P&L) and the paragraph after its table
working: X lots: t1 100 for 1,000 (10 each); t2 100 for 1,400 (14 each). Book 2,400 on 200, average 12.
t3 (2026-03-02) returns 1.00 per unit on the 200 held: lot t1 cost 1,000 - 100 = 900, lot t2 1,400 - 100 = 1,300; nothing beyond cost, nothing realized. Book 2,400 - 200 = 2,200, average 11.
t4 sells 150 for 2,250 (15 each). Trade FIFO: 100 of lot t1 cost 900 -> 1,500 - 900 = 600; 50 of lot t2 cost 1,300 x 50/100 = 650 -> 750 - 650 = 100. Trade t1 P&L = 700.00 (50 still held, open).
Position X (average cost): t4 takes 150/200 of 2,200: Book = 2,200 x 50/200 = 550.00; Avg = 550 / 50 = 11; Market = 50 x 15 = 750.00; unrealized = 750 - 550 = 200.00.

W: t5 10 for 20 (2 each). t6 returns 3.00 x 10 = 30 against cost 20: 10 beyond the cost is realized that day, the cost then 0. Trade t5 P&L = 10.00; its 10 units are still held, so the trade is open: closed = open.
Position W: qty 10, Book 0.00, Avg 0 / 10 = 0, Market 10 x 4 = 40.00, unrealized 40 - 0 = 40.00.

name: a short's average is what it brought in, less its commission
spec: SPEC.md §2 Trade (FIFO lots; P&L; Entry; Exit; Qty) (reversed for shorts); SPEC.md §2 Position (Qty; Book at average cost, commissions in; Avg cost; Market; P&L) and the paragraph after its table (a short's Book is what it brought in less its commission; P&L = Book - Market)
working: t1 short sale: cash +4,995, fee 5 -> value 5,000, 100 at 50. t2 short sale: 100 for 4,000, at 40. t3 buy to close: cash -2,255, fee 5 -> value 2,250, 50 at 45.

Trade (FIFO): t3 closes 50 of lot t1: (50 - 45) x 50 = 250, less exit commission 5 and the closed units' share of the entry commission 5 x 50/100 = 2.50: P&L = 242.50 = cash check 4,995 x 50/100 - 2,255. Direction short; 150 still short, open.
Position Book: what the shorts brought in less commission 4,995 + 4,000 = 8,995 on 200 (average 44.975). t3 takes 50/200: Book = 8,995 x 150/200 = 6,746.25.

name: an option's average is its premium per share of the underlying, as its quote is
spec: SPEC.md §2 Trade (FIFO lots; P&L; Entry; Exit; Qty) (options matched per contract, multiplier as stated); SPEC.md §2 Position (Qty; Book at average cost, commissions in; Avg cost; Market; P&L) and the paragraph after its table (Avg cost per share of the underlying; a contract written: what it brought in less commission)
working: C (multiplier 100): t1 writes 2, cash +598, fee 2 -> value 600 = 3.00 per share. t2 buys 1 back for 150 = 1.50 per share.
Trade t1: (3.00 - 1.50) x 1 x 100 = 150, less the closed contract's share of the entry commission 2 x 1/2 = 1, exit commission 0: P&L = 149.00 = cash check 598 / 2 - 150.
Position C short: qty 1; Book = 598 x 1/2 = 299.00; Avg = 299 / (1 x 100) = 2.99; Market = 1 x 1.20 x 100 = 120.00; unrealized = Book - Market = 179.00.
P (multiplier 100): t3 buys 3, cash -603, fee 3 -> value 600 = 2.00 per share. t4 sells 1 for 400 = 4.00 per share.
Trade t3: (4.00 - 2.00) x 1 x 100 = 200, less entry commission share 3 x 1/3 = 1: P&L = 199.00 = cash check 400 - 603 / 3.

name: a trade up in its own currency and down in CAD is a win, its negative CAD amount kept in the gross wins
spec: SPEC.md §2 Trade (FIFO lots; P&L; Entry; Exit; Qty) (P&L (CAD): each leg's notional converted on its own fill date); SPEC.md §4 Dashboard (KPI tiles; win/loss judged in the trade's own currency, sums in CAD, a negative CAD amount kept in Gross W, Avg win and Profit factor); §5 Filters (Result)
working: All three closed: count 3; wins 2 (U, X), losses 1 (Y), breakeven 0; win rate 2/3 = 0.666... (written as the nearest double).
Gross W = -48 + 60 = 12.00 (U's negative CAD amount kept, not clamped); Gross L = 100.00 (written positive); Avg win = 12 / 2 = 6.00; Avg loss = -100 / 1 = -100.00.
Result = Win keeps closed trades winning in their own currency: t1 (U), t3 (X): wins 2, losses 0. Result = Loss: t5 (Y): wins 0, losses 1.
